questions.text: Will Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta together report more than $250B of capex for the quarter ended March 31, 2027?
questions.test: YES if the sum of purchases of property and equipment (Microsoft: additions to property and equipment for Jan to Mar 2027, derived as nine-month minus six-month year-to-date figures; Amazon: gross purchases before proceeds) in each company's 10-Q cash flow statement for the three months ended March 31, 2027 exceeds $250.0B; NO otherwise.
questions.source: Form 10-Q filings on SEC EDGAR (Microsoft FY2027 Q3; Alphabet, Amazon, Meta Q1 2027)
questions.odds_basis: Estimate. Q3 2026 four-company capex was about $211B (Amazon about $77B, Alphabet $51.4B, Microsoft $45.2B, Meta about $38B from its $135B to $145B guide; secondary press tallies of the 10-Qs). Without a cut (44%) the trend clears $250B by Q1 2027 about 70% of the time; F7 fires if any one of four cuts (56%), and then about 35%. Blend about 50. Lens question from Manidis and Roberts, The Commanding Heights, Oct 29, 2026 (commanding-heights.com), which expects capex above $1T in 2027.

questions.text: By June 30, 2027, will any federal law, executive order or rule require a licence or prior approval before a frontier AI training run?
questions.test: YES if by Jun 30, 2027 an enacted statute, a signed executive order, or an interim or final rule in effect requires developers to obtain a licence, permit or prior federal approval before starting training runs above a stated compute or capability threshold. Notice-only or reporting-only rules do not count. NO otherwise.
questions.source: Federal Register and Congress.gov
questions.odds_basis: Estimate. E04 (Washington binds AI models) is 29 by May 2027 and counts any binding rule; a licence before a training run is the strictest form, so about 12. The paper calls it the most likely sovereign step (Manidis and Roberts, The Commanding Heights, Oct 29, 2026 (commanding-heights.com)).

questions.text: By June 30, 2027, will the US government take or agree to take equity, warrants or a golden share in OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI or Alphabet?
questions.test: YES if between Nov 26, 2026 and Jun 30, 2027 a federal department or agency release, a Federal Register notice, or a company SEC filing discloses that the US government holds, or has signed a binding agreement or letter of intent to acquire, any equity, warrant, convertible instrument or special voting share in OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI or Alphabet. Grants, contracts and compute purchases without equity do not count. NO otherwise.
questions.source: Federal Register; department press releases; SEC EDGAR filings of Anthropic and Alphabet
questions.odds_basis: Estimate. Precedent for the actor: since Aug 2025 Washington has taken equity or a golden share in Intel, MP Materials, Lithium Americas, Trilogy Metals and US Steel, but never in an AI lab. About 15 in seven months. The paper expects quiet federal control of frontier labs (Manidis and Roberts, The Commanding Heights, Oct 29, 2026 (commanding-heights.com)).

questions.text: Will TCS end fiscal 2027 with fewer employees than a year earlier while its full-year operating profit rises?
questions.test: From TCS's Q4 FY2027 results release and fact sheet: YES if total workforce at March 31, 2027 is below workforce at March 31, 2026 AND consolidated FY2027 operating income (EBIT, INR, excluding exceptional items as TCS reports it) is above FY2026; NO otherwise.
questions.source: Tata Consultancy Services Q4 FY2027 results and fact sheet filed with BSE and NSE
questions.odds_basis: Estimate. TCS cut about 2% of its workforce from July 2025 and its headcount fell through fiscal 2026 while operating profit grew slowly; both legs must hold again for fiscal 2027. About 45. The paper expects Indian IT headcount down with profits up (Manidis and Roberts, The Commanding Heights, Oct 29, 2026 (commanding-heights.com)).

questions.text: Does Anthropic (Nasdaq: ANT) close below its $83 IPO price on any trading day from Nov 22, 2026 through Mar 31, 2027?

questions.source: Nasdaq official closing prices for ANT
